key: KIKI: ...
en: KIKI: ...
ja: キキ: ……

key: VICTORIA: There you go-- just focus on breathing.
en: VICTORIA: There you go-- just focus on breathing.
ja: ヴィクトリア: そう、それでいいです――呼吸に集中して。

key: Like in Beginning Meditation, right?
en: Like in Beginning Meditation, right?
ja: 「めい想入門」でやったとおりに、ですよね?

key: Keep it steady. You're okay.
en: Keep it steady. You're okay.
ja: 落ち着いて。大丈夫ですから。

key: KIKI: "Okay" is a rather generous assessment of either my condition or the circumstances.
en: KIKI: "Okay" is a rather generous assessment of either my condition or the circumstances.
ja: キキ: 「大丈夫」とは、わたしの状態にも、この状況にも、いささか甘い評価だ。

key: There's no longer any point to saving face.
en: There's no longer any point to saving face.
ja: もう、体裁を取りつくろう意味もない。

key: After a display like that-- collapsing in the courtyard...
en: After a display like that-- collapsing in the courtyard...
ja: あんな醜態を見せたあとでは――中庭で倒れるなど……

key: Who wouldn't be shaken?
en: Who wouldn't be shaken?
ja: 動揺せずにいられる者などいまい。

key: VICTORIA: You're being too hard on yourself!
en: VICTORIA: You're being too hard on yourself!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 自分に厳しすぎます!

key: Nobody could be as strong as you've been through all of this.
en: Nobody could be as strong as you've been through all of this.
ja: こんな状況を通して、先生ほど強くいられる人なんて他にいません。

key: Look at everything you've done, all the people you've made happy, and--
en: Look at everything you've done, all the people you've made happy, and--
ja: これまでやってきたこと、幸せにしてきた人たちのこと、見てください、それに――

key: KIKI: And for as strong as I've been, I'm still too weak.
en: KIKI: And for as strong as I've been, I'm still too weak.
ja: キキ: それでも、これほど強くあり続けてなお、わたしはまだ弱すぎる。

key: VICTORIA: Please calm down.
en: VICTORIA: Please calm down.
ja: ヴィクトリア: どうか、落ち着いてください。

key: KIKI: How can I?
en: KIKI: How can I?
ja: キキ: どうやって落ち着けと?

key: "Defeat the inner chaos?"
en: "Defeat the inner chaos?"
ja: 「内なるこんとんを打ち破れ」?

key: Did you think I was only talking about zen of the mind?
en: Did you think I was only talking about zen of the mind?
ja: それが、心の禅のことだけを言っていたと思ったか?

key: I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up just that.
en: I could be centered to dead-zero and I will still end up just that.
ja: わたしがどれほど心を無に近づけようと、行き着く先はやはり「死」だ。

key: No amount of meditation is going to change the simple fact that my body is killing itself!
en: No amount of meditation is going to change the simple fact that my body is killing itself!
ja: どれだけめい想を重ねようと、この体が自らをむしばんでいるという単純な事実は変わらない!

key: VICTORIA: That's enough!
en: VICTORIA: That's enough!
ja: ヴィクトリア: もうやめてください!

key: You know what hurts even more than seeing this happen to you?!
en: You know what hurts even more than seeing this happen to you?!
ja: こんなことが先生の身に起きるのを見るより、何がつらいか分かりますか?!

key: Watching you do it to yourself!
en: Watching you do it to yourself!
ja: 先生が自分自身にそれをしているのを見ることです!

key: Sometimes people get sick-- big fucking deal!
en: Sometimes people get sick-- big fucking deal!
ja: 人は病気になることだってある――それがどうしたっていうんです!

key: Even then, they get through it with the people near and dear to them.
en: Even then, they get through it with the people near and dear to them.
ja: それでも、大切な人たちと一緒に、それを乗り越えていくものでしょう。

key: What they DON'T do is lie to everyone around them and go on pretending that everything is fine and dandy when it's clearly anything but!
en: What they DON'T do is lie to everyone around them and go on pretending that everything is fine and dandy when it's clearly anything but!
ja: やっちゃいけないのは、周りの人みんなにうそをついて、明らかにそうじゃないのに、すべて順調なフリを続けることです!

key: You've put all this pressure on yourself to try and maintain perfect appearances and outward peace,
en: You've put all this pressure on yourself to try and maintain perfect appearances and outward peace,
ja: 完璧な見た目と、表向きの平穏を保とうとして、先生は自分にプレッシャーをかけ続けてきました。

key: But really you're tearing yourself up inside as much as anyone!?
en: But really you're tearing yourself up inside as much as anyone!?
ja: でも本当は、誰よりも自分の内側をズタズタにしてるんじゃないですか!?

key: Don't you see the irony you've committed yourself to being a victim of?
en: Don't you see the irony you've committed yourself to being a victim of?
ja: 自分が身を投じてしまった、その皮肉に気づいてないんですか?

key: KIKI: Of course, you're correct.
en: KIKI: Of course, you're correct.
ja: キキ: もちろん、そのとおりだ。

key: I am keenly aware of the folly of it all.
en: I am keenly aware of the folly of it all.
ja: この愚かさは、わたし自身、痛いほど分かっている。

key: And despite my lectures, my practice, and my teaching, I've been unable to stop it.
en: And despite my lectures, my practice, and my teaching, I've been unable to stop it.
ja: わたしの講義も、修行も、教えも、それを止めることはできなかった。

key: That, too, has been a great source of shame to me.
en: That, too, has been a great source of shame to me.
ja: それもまた、わたしにとって大きな恥だ。

key: How can I advocate for mental and spiritual health when I can't even maintain it for myself?
en: How can I advocate for mental and spiritual health when I can't even maintain it for myself?
ja: 自分自身の心すら保てないというのに、どうして心と精神の健やかさを説けようか。

key: I have felt I was a sham for so long that lying about this was only natural.
en: I have felt I was a sham for so long that lying about this was only natural.
ja: 自分がまがい物だと、ずっと感じ続けてきたからこそ、これについてうそをつくのも当然のことだった。

key: VICTORIA: Then come clean.
en: VICTORIA: Then come clean.
ja: ヴィクトリア: なら、正直に打ち明けてください。

key: Be honest about it, and we can all start figuring out how to get through it together.
en: Be honest about it, and we can all start figuring out how to get through it together.
ja: 正直に話してくれれば、みんなで一緒に乗り越える方法を考え始められます。

key: Then there is one more matter I must be transparent about.
en: Then there is one more matter I must be transparent about.
ja: ならば、もうひとつ、正直に話しておかねばならないことがある。

key: VICTORIA: ...What?
en: VICTORIA: ...What?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……何ですか?

key: KIKI: \PN.
en: KIKI: \PN.
ja: キキ: \PN。

key: I cannot give you Strength.
en: I cannot give you Strength.
ja: あなたに「かいりき」を渡すことができない。

key: VICTORIA: What.
en: VICTORIA: What.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何ですって。

key: KIKI: The Machine went missing from my care not too long ago.
en: KIKI: The Machine went missing from my care not too long ago.
ja: キキ: あのマシンは、少し前にわたしの管理下から姿を消した。

key: I believe it was stolen.
en: I believe it was stolen.
ja: 盗まれたのだと思う。

key: VICTORIA: Then, all of these hoops about graduation...
en: VICTORIA: Then, all of these hoops about graduation...
ja: ヴィクトリア: では、この卒業試験だとか何だとかいうのは……

key: KIKI: The urgency has not escaped me.
en: KIKI: The urgency has not escaped me.
ja: キキ: この緊急性は、わたしとて分かっている。

key: I hoped I would be able to recover it before you completed these tasks.
en: I hoped I would be able to recover it before you completed these tasks.
ja: あなたたちがこの課題を終えるまでに、取り戻せるだろうと期待していた。

key: But, as you can imagine--
en: But, as you can imagine--
ja: だが、想像がつくとおり――

key: VICTORIA: I can't believe you.
en: VICTORIA: I can't believe you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 信じられません。

key: KIKI: Victoria!
en: KIKI: Victoria!
ja: キキ: ヴィクトリア!

key: KIKI: Please leave me.
en: KIKI: Please leave me.
ja: キキ: 一人にしてくれ。

key: I wish to be alone right now.
en: I wish to be alone right now.
ja: 今は、一人になりたい。

key: KIKI: I'm sorry.
en: KIKI: I'm sorry.
ja: キキ: すまない。

key: VICTORIA: So, that's it.
en: VICTORIA: So, that's it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: つまり、そういうことですか。

key: Apophyll is safe,
en: Apophyll is safe,
ja: アポフィルは無事。

key: And empty.
en: And empty.
ja: そして、空っぽ。

key: CAIN: Hey, we did everything we could...
en: CAIN: Hey, we did everything we could...
ja: カイン: ねえ、ボクらできることは全部やったんだよ……

key: VICTORIA: Like that's some kind of justification or reassurance?
en: VICTORIA: Like that's some kind of justification or reassurance?
ja: ヴィクトリア: それが何かの言い訳や慰めにでもなるとでも?

key: We did everything we could-- and it still wasn't enough!
en: We did everything we could-- and it still wasn't enough!
ja: できることは全部やった――それでも足りなかった!

key: Luckily we can take comfort in knowing it wasn't our negligence that ended her life, just our incompetence.
en: Luckily we can take comfort in knowing it wasn't our negligence that ended her life, just our incompetence.
ja: せめてもの救いは、先生の命を奪ったのが私たちの怠慢じゃなくて、単なる無能さだったって分かることぐらいですね。

key: But maybe it was the first thing too.
en: But maybe it was the first thing too.
ja: でも、もしかしたら怠慢の方もあったのかもしれない。

key: I was the one who brought Cal here--
en: I was the one who brought Cal here--
ja: キャルをここに連れてきたのは、わたしです――

key: I should've known he was one of them!
en: I should've known he was one of them!
ja: あいつが連中の一人だって、気づくべきだったのに!

key: CAIN: How could you have known?
en: CAIN: How could you have known?
ja: カイン: どうやって気づけっていうのさ?

key: VICTORIA: Oh, I don't know, maybe a hair-trigger temper might have been something of a red flag.
en: VICTORIA: Oh, I don't know, maybe a hair-trigger temper might have been something of a red flag.
ja: ヴィクトリア: さあ、分かりませんけど、あのすぐキレる性格くらい、危険信号になってもよかったんじゃないですか。

key: I was stupid.
en: I was stupid.
ja: わたし、バカでした。

key: CAIN: Hey, blaming yourself isn't going to help.
en: CAIN: Hey, blaming yourself isn't going to help.
ja: カイン: ねえ、自分を責めたって、どうにもならないよ。

key: VICTORIA: ...
en: VICTORIA: ...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……

key: Sure.
en: Sure.
ja: そうですね。

key: Better to blame the real culprits.
en: Better to blame the real culprits.
ja: それなら、本当の元凶を責めた方がいい。

key: Team Meteor.
en: Team Meteor.
ja: チームメテオを。

key: Better to do what we can to make sure this doesn't happen to anyone else.
en: Better to do what we can to make sure this doesn't happen to anyone else.
ja: 他の誰にもこんなことが起きないよう、できることをした方がいい。

key: There was another PULSE-- somewhere in Byxbysion Wasteland.
en: There was another PULSE-- somewhere in Byxbysion Wasteland.
ja: もう一体パルスがいるはずです――ビクスビジョン荒地のどこかに。

key: And that's where your family is.
en: And that's where your family is.
ja: あなたの家族がいるのも、そこですよね。

key: Do I have that right?
en: Do I have that right?
ja: 合ってますか?

key: CAIN: Um, yeah, but...
en: CAIN: Um, yeah, but...
ja: カイン: あー、うん、そうだけど……

key: My family and I aren't really...
en: My family and I aren't really...
ja: ボクと家族って、そんなに……

key: VICTORIA: What?
en: VICTORIA: What?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何です?

key: So you're not on great terms, and you're just going to let them become the next victims?
en: So you're not on great terms, and you're just going to let them become the next victims?
ja: つまり、あまり仲が良くないから、次の犠牲者にさせてもいいってことですか?

key: CAIN: I didn't say that...
en: CAIN: I didn't say that...
ja: カイン: そんなこと、言ってないよ……

key: VICTORIA: You didn't have to.
en: VICTORIA: You didn't have to.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 言う必要もありませんでした。

key: You have a chance to save them, and you're hesitating.
en: You have a chance to save them, and you're hesitating.
ja: 助けられるチャンスがあるのに、ためらってるじゃないですか。

key: Maybe this is why you have to tell yourself things like "You did everything you could."
en: Maybe this is why you have to tell yourself things like "You did everything you could."
ja: だからこそ「できることは全部やった」なんて、自分に言い聞かせなきゃいけないんじゃないですか。

key: CAIN: Okay, I'm... just gonna go.
en: CAIN: Okay, I'm... just gonna go.
ja: カイン: ……もう、行くよ。

key: VICTORIA: Wait, I'm sorry, I didn't mean--
en: VICTORIA: Wait, I'm sorry, I didn't mean--
ja: ヴィクトリア: 待って、ごめんなさい、そんなつもりじゃ――

key: VICTORIA: I'm sorry, that was uncalled for.
en: VICTORIA: I'm sorry, that was uncalled for.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ごめんなさい、今のは言いすぎでした。

key: I... have a lot of work to do.
en: I... have a lot of work to do.
ja: わたし……やることが山ほどあります。

key: On myself, and...
en: On myself, and...
ja: 自分自身のことも、それに……

key: Well, someone needs to lead the academy now.
en: Well, someone needs to lead the academy now.
ja: まあ、今はこのアカデミーを誰かが率いなきゃいけませんし。

key: Kiki chose me.
en: Kiki chose me.
ja: キキ先生が、わたしを選んでくれました。

key: She expected that she was on her way out, but...
en: She expected that she was on her way out, but...
ja: 先生は、自分が去る日が来ることを覚悟していたようですけど……

key: Not like this.
en: Not like this.
ja: こんな形で、じゃなかったはずです。

key: VICTORIA: Well, you can go on without me.
en: VICTORIA: Well, you can go on without me.
ja: ヴィクトリア: では、わたし抜きで進んでください。

key: VICTORIA: I'm grateful that I had the chance to fight alongside you.
en: VICTORIA: I'm grateful that I had the chance to fight alongside you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたと共に戦えたこと、感謝しています。

key: But this is where our adventure ends.
en: But this is where our adventure ends.
ja: でも、わたしたちの冒険はここで終わりです。

key: At least, my part of it.
en: At least, my part of it.
ja: 少なくとも、わたしの分は。

key: VICTORIA: It looks like this is where my adventure ends.
en: VICTORIA: It looks like this is where my adventure ends.
ja: ヴィクトリア: どうやら、わたしの冒険はここで終わりのようです。

key: Someone is going to have to tell the other students.
en: Someone is going to have to tell the other students.
ja: 誰かが、他の生徒たちに伝えなきゃいけません。

key: And I have no intention of keeping secrets.
en: And I have no intention of keeping secrets.
ja: それに、秘密にしておくつもりもありません。

key: And then class schedules, lectures, maintenance, paperwork, intake...
en: And then class schedules, lectures, maintenance, paperwork, intake...
ja: それに授業の予定、講義、施設の管理、事務仕事、入学対応……

key: VICTORIA: There's so much to do...
en: VICTORIA: There's so much to do...
ja: ヴィクトリア: やることが、本当にたくさんあります……

key: VICTORIA: You'll keep fighting Team Meteor, won't you?
en: VICTORIA: You'll keep fighting Team Meteor, won't you?
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたは、これからもチームメテオと戦い続けるんですよね?

key: Byxbysion Wasteland...
en: Byxbysion Wasteland...
ja: ビクスビジョン荒地……

key: The entrance is from a large door in South Obsidia.
en: The entrance is from a large door in South Obsidia.
ja: 入り口は、南オブシディアにある大きな扉です。

key: You know it?
en: You know it?
ja: ご存じですか?

key: Someone has to go there and make sure they can't hurt anyone else.
en: Someone has to go there and make sure they can't hurt anyone else.
ja: 誰かがそこへ行って、もう誰も傷つけられないようにしなきゃいけません。

key: Cain evidently won't do it, so...
en: Cain evidently won't do it, so...
ja: カインは明らかにやらなさそうなので……

key: It falls to you.
en: It falls to you.
ja: あなたに任せます。

key: We're all behind you, \PN.
en: We're all behind you, \PN.
ja: みんな、あなたを支持しています、\PN。

key: Make sure they pay for what they did.
en: Make sure they pay for what they did.
ja: あの人たちに、やったことの報いを必ず受けさせてください。

key: VICTORIA: You were always the stronger one between us anyway.
en: VICTORIA: You were always the stronger one between us anyway.
ja: ヴィクトリア: どのみち、わたしたちの中で強いのは、いつだってあなたでしたから。

key: Oh, the Machine Strength--
en: Oh, the Machine Strength--
ja: あ、それと「かいりき」のマシンですけど――

key: ...I have a theory where it might have gone.
en: ...I have a theory where it might have gone.
ja: ……どこへ行ったか、心当たりがあります。

key: If it turns up, I'll be sure to get in touch with you.
en: If it turns up, I'll be sure to get in touch with you.
ja: 見つかったら、必ず連絡します。

key: The kids, the wasteland, and the city...
en: The kids, the wasteland, and the city...
ja: 子どもたち、荒地、そして街……

key: We'll save everyone.
en: We'll save everyone.
ja: みんな、必ず救います。

key: We have to.
en: We have to.
ja: そうしなきゃいけません。

key: KIKI: Thank you for speaking with me.
en: KIKI: Thank you for speaking with me.
ja: キキ: 話をしてくれて感謝する。

key: It sounds like there is much to be done, but first,
en: It sounds like there is much to be done, but first,
ja: やるべきことは多いようだが、その前に、

key: As a new student, I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
en: As a new student, I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
ja: 新しい生徒として、わたしの弟子を紹介したい。

key: I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
en: I'd like you to meet my apprentice.
ja: わたしの弟子を紹介したい。

key: Victoria?
en: Victoria?
ja: ヴィクトリア?

key: KIKI: We have a new student.
en: KIKI: We have a new student.
ja: キキ: 新しい生徒だ。

key: Would you please walk them through enrollment and introduce them to the basic facilities as I previously showed you?
en: Would you please walk them through enrollment and introduce them to the basic facilities as I previously showed you?
ja: 以前案内したように、入学手続きと基本的な施設の案内を、この者にしてやってくれるか?

key: KIKI: We have a visitor with some very important news.
en: KIKI: We have a visitor with some very important news.
ja: キキ: とても重要な知らせを持った訪問者だ。

key: I believe it will be prudent for you to hear them out as well.
en: I believe it will be prudent for you to hear them out as well.
ja: あなたも、話を聞いておいた方がいいだろう。

key: VICTORIA: Um,
en: VICTORIA: Um,
ja: ヴィクトリア: あの、

key: Haha?
en: Haha?
ja: はは?

key: Hi, \PN!
en: Hi, \PN!
ja: こんにちは、\PN!

key: KIKI: ...Oh?
en: KIKI: ...Oh?
ja: キキ: ……おや?

key: VICTORIA: Sensei, \PN and I already met in Reborn City!
en: VICTORIA: Sensei, \PN and I already met in Reborn City!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 先生、\PNとは、もうリボーンシティで会ってるんです!

key: She's the one I told you about who rescued me!
en: She's the one I told you about who rescued me!
ja: 先生に話した、わたしを助けてくれた人です!

key: They're the one I told you about who rescued me!
en: They're the one I told you about who rescued me!
ja: 先生に話した、わたしを助けてくれた人です!

key: He's the one I told you about who rescued me!
en: He's the one I told you about who rescued me!
ja: 先生に話した、わたしを助けてくれた人です!

key: KIKI: I see...
en: KIKI: I see...
ja: キキ: なるほど……

key: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents she brings might be baseless.
en: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents she brings might be baseless.
ja: 正直に言えば、この者が運んできた不吉な知らせが、根も葉もないものであってほしいと、わたしの心のどこかで願っていた。

key: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents they bring might be baseless.
en: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents they bring might be baseless.
ja: 正直に言えば、この者が運んできた不吉な知らせが、根も葉もないものであってほしいと、わたしの心のどこかで願っていた。

key: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents he brings might be baseless.
en: I confess, a part of me had hoped that the ill portents he brings might be baseless.
ja: 正直に言えば、この者が運んできた不吉な知らせが、根も葉もないものであってほしいと、わたしの心のどこかで願っていた。

key: But in that case, I suppose it is fortunate that we need not waste time doubting their credibility.
en: But in that case, I suppose it is fortunate that we need not waste time doubting their credibility.
ja: だが、そういうことならば、この者の信ぴょう性を疑う手間が省けたのは、幸いというべきかもしれない。

key: VICTORIA: ...Wait, is something wrong?
en: VICTORIA: ...Wait, is something wrong?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……待って、何かあったんですか?

key: KIKI: Children have been kidnapped, it seems,
en: KIKI: Children have been kidnapped, it seems,
ja: キキ: どうやら、子どもたちがさらわれたようだ。

key: And in the same breath, something threatens to run afoul of our Academy.
en: And in the same breath, something threatens to run afoul of our Academy.
ja: そして同時に、何かがこのアカデミーに害をなそうとしている。

key: I have built our home here up from sand and ashes in equal part.
en: I have built our home here up from sand and ashes in equal part.
ja: わたしはこの家を、砂と灰を等しく重ねて築き上げてきた。

key: I will not let it return to them.
en: I will not let it return to them.
ja: それを、再び砂と灰に還すつもりはない。

key: You may rest assured that I will defend this place to my final breath.
en: You may rest assured that I will defend this place to my final breath.
ja: 最後の息をするまで、この場所を守り抜くと約束しよう。

key: VICTORIA: So, it's another PULSE...?
en: VICTORIA: So, it's another PULSE...?
ja: ヴィクトリア: つまり、また別のパルスが……?

key: But we don't know what kind.
en: But we don't know what kind.
ja: でも、どんな種類かは分からない。

key: KIKI: We will issue a bulletin to all of the students.
en: KIKI: We will issue a bulletin to all of the students.
ja: キキ: 生徒全員に通達を出そう。

key: Any suspicious machinery or activity anywhere on the beach should be reported to us at once.
en: Any suspicious machinery or activity anywhere on the beach should be reported to us at once.
ja: 浜辺のどこであれ、怪しい機械や動きを見たら、すぐに報告するようにと。

key: VICTORIA: I'll have Lettie send out the word; it'll spread like wildfire.
en: VICTORIA: I'll have Lettie send out the word; it'll spread like wildfire.
ja: ヴィクトリア: レティに知らせを回してもらいます、あっという間に広まるはずです。

key: KIKI: Then we need only wait for news to come in.
en: KIKI: Then we need only wait for news to come in.
ja: キキ: では、あとは知らせが入るのを待つだけだ。

key: That leaves the matter of the children.
en: That leaves the matter of the children.
ja: 残るは、子どもたちの件だな。

key: VICTORIA: By children, that wouldn't happen to be...
en: VICTORIA: By children, that wouldn't happen to be...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 子どもたちというと、もしかして……

key: ...Shelly, too?
en: ...Shelly, too?
ja: ……シェリーも、ですか?

key: VICTORIA: How did this happen...?
en: VICTORIA: How did this happen...?
ja: ヴィクトリア: どうしてこんなことに……?

key: Well, what's important is saving them!
en: Well, what's important is saving them!
ja: とにかく、大事なのは彼らを救うことです!

key: If it's just a bit of debris in the way, then we can definitely help!
en: If it's just a bit of debris in the way, then we can definitely help!
ja: ただの障害物があるだけなら、絶対に手伝えます!

key: Sensei, you'll let \PN take the Machine Strength, right?
en: Sensei, you'll let \PN take the Machine Strength, right?
ja: 先生、\PNに「かいりき」を渡してあげますよね?

key: It's true that Strength is typically bestowed on the graduates of our Academy,
en: It's true that Strength is typically bestowed on the graduates of our Academy,
ja: たしかに「かいりき」は、通常このアカデミーの卒業生に授けられるものだ。

key: Yet, to give it freely without meeting the same measures of achievement...
en: Yet, to give it freely without meeting the same measures of achievement...
ja: しかし、同じだけの成果を求めずに、無条件に与えるとなれば……

key: It is intrinsically disrespectful to those who have properly completed the program.
en: It is intrinsically disrespectful to those who have properly completed the program.
ja: それは本質的に、正規の課程を修めた者たちへの侮辱になる。

key: One must attain inner strength before acquiring worldly power.
en: One must attain inner strength before acquiring worldly power.
ja: 世俗の力を手にする前に、内なる強さを得なければならない。

key: VICTORIA: But Sensei, this is an emergency! Surely you can--
en: VICTORIA: But Sensei, this is an emergency! Surely you can--
ja: ヴィクトリア: でも先生、これは緊急事態です! きっと――

key: KIKI: Victoria.
en: KIKI: Victoria.
ja: キキ: ヴィクトリア。

key: Please,
en: Please,
ja: どうか、

key: Even in the most pressing of circumstances, we must remain calm and in control.
en: Even in the most pressing of circumstances, we must remain calm and in control.
ja: どれほど差し迫った状況であろうと、わたしたちは冷静さと制御を保たねばならない。

key: Indeed, these cases are when it is most necessary to do so.
en: Indeed, these cases are when it is most necessary to do so.
ja: むしろ、こういうときこそ、それが最も必要とされる。

key: Strife gives way to panic.
en: Strife gives way to panic.
ja: 争いはパニックを招く。

key: Panic, to chaos.
en: Panic, to chaos.
ja: パニックは、こんとんを招く。

key: Yet it is order that will save the day.
en: Yet it is order that will save the day.
ja: だが、事態を救うのは秩序だ。

key: VICTORIA: ...Yes, Sensei.
en: VICTORIA: ...Yes, Sensei.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……はい、先生。

key: KIKI: ...And in any case, I was going to continue,
en: KIKI: ...And in any case, I was going to continue,
ja: キキ: ……それに、いずれにせよ、話は続く。

key: That disrespect must be weighed carefully against the immediacy of our circumstances.
en: That disrespect must be weighed carefully against the immediacy of our circumstances.
ja: その侮辱は、今の状況の緊急性と、慎重に天びんにかけねばならない。

key: Discretion is the better part of law.
en: Discretion is the better part of law.
ja: 思慮分別こそ、規律に勝る。

key: Allow me to bend our customs to our current needs.
en: Allow me to bend our customs to our current needs.
ja: 今の必要のために、わたしたちの慣習を曲げることを許してほしい。

key: If you can prove that your power is equal to that of our top representatives, no one will be in a position to protest the requisition of Strength.
en: If you can prove that your power is equal to that of our top representatives, no one will be in a position to protest the requisition of Strength.
ja: あなたの力が、わたしたちの代表格に匹敵すると証明できれば、誰も「かいりき」の授与に異を唱えられないだろう。

key: I believe this is the fairest way to expedite the usual process.
en: I believe this is the fairest way to expedite the usual process.
ja: これが、通常の手順を早める、最も公正な方法だと思う。

key: VICTORIA: Understood.
en: VICTORIA: Understood.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 分かりました。

key: In other words, \PN just has to defeat me in battle, correct?
en: In other words, \PN just has to defeat me in battle, correct?
ja: つまり、\PNがわたしを戦いで倒せばいい、ということですね?

key: Correct, although...
en: Correct, although...
ja: そのとおりだ、ただし……

key: Our other newest student would suffice as well.
en: Our other newest student would suffice as well.
ja: もう一人の新入生でも構わない。

key: Our newest student would suffice as well.
en: Our newest student would suffice as well.
ja: 新入生でも構わない。

key: You are both exceptionally skilled.
en: You are both exceptionally skilled.
ja: あなたたちは二人とも、並外れた実力を持っている。

key: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN has actually defeated Cal before!
en: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN has actually defeated Cal before!
ja: ヴィクトリア: あ、\PNは実は、以前キャルを倒してるんです!

key: KIKI: Is that so?
en: KIKI: Is that so?
ja: キキ: そうなのか?

key: ...But he has taken to our program like fish to water.
en: ...But he has taken to our program like fish to water.
ja: ……だが、彼はこの課程に、水を得た魚のようになじんでいる。

key: I believe it would be quite beneficial for him to have a rematch now that he has regained some control over himself.
en: I believe it would be quite beneficial for him to have a rematch now that he has regained some control over himself.
ja: 自分をいくらか制御できるようになった今、再戦することは、彼にとって大いに有益だろう。

key: VICTORIA: Admittedly, I am curious how he would do now...
en: VICTORIA: Admittedly, I am curious how he would do now...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 正直、今の彼がどうなるか、興味はあります……

key: KIKI: ...Hm?
en: KIKI: ...Hm?
ja: キキ: ……ん?

key: You already went and faced him again?
en: You already went and faced him again?
ja: もう再び彼と戦ってきたのか?

key: VICTORIA: Wait, really?
en: VICTORIA: Wait, really?
ja: ヴィクトリア: え、本当に?

key: KIKI: I see you are ahead of the curve.
en: KIKI: I see you are ahead of the curve.
ja: キキ: 一歩先を行っていたようだな。

key: ...Very well, there need be no further dallying then.
en: ...Very well, there need be no further dallying then.
ja: ……よろしい、ならばこれ以上ためらう必要はない。

key: Give Victoria and I just a moment to stay abreast of the situation for our respective parts, and then we will proceed.
en: Give Victoria and I just a moment to stay abreast of the situation for our respective parts, and then we will proceed.
ja: ヴィクトリアとわたしに、それぞれの持ち場の状況を把握する時間を少し与えてくれ、それから進めよう。

key: KIKI: But he is on a retreat atop Pyrous Mountain,
en: KIKI: But he is on a retreat atop Pyrous Mountain,
ja: キキ: だが彼は今、パイロス山の上で修行に入っている。

key: And time is of the essence.
en: And time is of the essence.
ja: そして、時間が惜しい状況だ。

key: I believe it is most prudent to let \PN decide.
en: I believe it is most prudent to let \PN decide.
ja: \PNに選ばせるのが、最も賢明だろう。

key: You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
en: You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
ja: わたしの弟子ヴィクトリア、あるいは我らが新たなエース、キャル、どちらと戦ってもよい。

key: After you defeat one of them, you may apply for expedient graduation.
en: After you defeat one of them, you may apply for expedient graduation.
ja: どちらかを倒せば、特例での卒業を申請できる。

key: The choice is yours.
en: The choice is yours.
ja: 選ぶのは、あなただ。

key: VICTORIA: I'll let Lettie know what's going on right away.
en: VICTORIA: I'll let Lettie know what's going on right away.
ja: ヴィクトリア: すぐにレティに状況を伝えます。

key: If you decide to fight me, I'll be waiting in the courtyard!
en: If you decide to fight me, I'll be waiting in the courtyard!
ja: わたしと戦うと決めたら、中庭で待っていますね!

key: KIKI: You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
en: KIKI: You may face my apprentice, Victoria, or our newest ace, Cal.
ja: キキ: わたしの弟子ヴィクトリア、あるいは我らが新たなエース、キャル、どちらと戦ってもよい。

key: You will find Victoria in the courtyard, and Cal atop Pyrous Mountain to the southwest.
en: You will find Victoria in the courtyard, and Cal atop Pyrous Mountain to the southwest.
ja: ヴィクトリアは中庭に、キャルは南西のパイロス山の上にいる。

key: One additional forewarning:
en: One additional forewarning:
ja: もうひとつ、忠告しておこう。

key: The Machine Strength cannot be used without its requisite badge.
en: The Machine Strength cannot be used without its requisite badge.
ja: 「かいりき」のマシンは、対応するバッジがなければ使用できない。

key: In the early days of our academy, I was once its Leader too.
en: In the early days of our academy, I was once its Leader too.
ja: このアカデミーの初期には、わたし自身もそのリーダーだった。

key: But recent events have forced me to evaluate my priorities, and I stepped away from the role.
en: But recent events have forced me to evaluate my priorities, and I stepped away from the role.
ja: しかし、最近の出来事のせいで、優先すべきことを見直さざるを得なくなり、その役目からは退いた。

key: Regardless, be aware of the upcoming obstacles.
en: Regardless, be aware of the upcoming obstacles.
ja: いずれにせよ、この先の障害には気をつけておくように。

key: KIKI: Thank you for waiting.
en: KIKI: Thank you for waiting.
ja: キキ: 待たせたな。

key: The students have been notified, and in a community this small, word will move quickly.
en: The students have been notified, and in a community this small, word will move quickly.
ja: 生徒たちには知らせが行き渡った。これほど小さな集団なら、話はすぐに広まるだろう。

key: KIKI: I understand you've beaten Victoria, then.
en: KIKI: I understand you've beaten Victoria, then.
ja: キキ: では、ヴィクトリアを倒したのだな。

key: ...And Cal as well?
en: ...And Cal as well?
ja: ……そしてキャルもか?

key: VICTORIA: Wait, what?
en: VICTORIA: Wait, what?
ja: ヴィクトリア: え、何ですか?

key: KIKI: Impressive, especially on such limited time.
en: KIKI: Impressive, especially on such limited time.
ja: キキ: 見事だ、これほど限られた時間でとは、特に。

key: KIKI: I presume you've beaten Cal, then.
en: KIKI: I presume you've beaten Cal, then.
ja: キキ: では、キャルを倒したのだろうな。

key: That leaves only one matter to resolve.
en: That leaves only one matter to resolve.
ja: 残る課題は、あとひとつだけだ。

key: As I said, you...
en: As I said, you...
ja: 言った通り、あなたは……

key: Ah--
en: Ah--
ja: ああ――

key: VICTORIA: ...Sensei?
en: VICTORIA: ...Sensei?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……先生?

key: KIKI: Apologies; I lost myself for a moment there.
en: KIKI: Apologies; I lost myself for a moment there.
ja: キキ: すまない、少し放心していたようだ。

key: I am quite all right.
en: I am quite all right.
ja: わたしは至って元気だ。

key: KIKI: What was I saying?
en: KIKI: What was I saying?
ja: キキ: 何の話をしていたか。

key: Ah, right-- Graduation.
en: Ah, right-- Graduation.
ja: ああ、そうだ――卒業についてだ。

key: I will be the one to give the final exam.
en: I will be the one to give the final exam.
ja: 最終試験は、わたしが執り行う。

key: VICTORIA: You...?
en: VICTORIA: You...?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 先生が、ですか?

key: Surely that's not necessary--
en: Surely that's not necessary--
ja: そんな必要はないはずです――

key: Please, trust me.
en: Please, trust me.
ja: どうか、わたしを信じてほしい。

key: Willpower is a muscle.
en: Willpower is a muscle.
ja: 意志の力は、筋肉のようなものだ。

key: Mine must remain strong as well.
en: Mine must remain strong as well.
ja: わたしのものも、強く保たねばならない。

key: It is only through fighting with all of our might that we can truly defeat the chaos within.
en: It is only through fighting with all of our might that we can truly defeat the chaos within.
ja: 全力で戦ってこそ、内なるこんとんに真に打ち勝つことができる。

key: Please allow me to do so.
en: Please allow me to do so.
ja: どうか、そうさせてほしい。

key: KIKI: The graduation exam takes the form of a six- on-six Singles Pokémon battle.
en: KIKI: The graduation exam takes the form of a six- on-six Singles Pokémon battle.
ja: キキ: 卒業試験は、6対6のシングルポケモンバトルという形を取る。

key: As is tradition, and the responsibility of the Academy's head, I will administer it.
en: As is tradition, and the responsibility of the Academy's head, I will administer it.
ja: 伝統に則り、そしてアカデミー長としての責務として、わたしがこれを執り行う。

key: This is a valuable opportunity for you to observe, Victoria.
en: This is a valuable opportunity for you to observe, Victoria.
ja: ヴィクトリア、これはあなたにとって貴重な見学の機会になるはずだ。

key: KIKI: You may speak to me in the courtyard when you are ready, \PN.
en: KIKI: You may speak to me in the courtyard when you are ready, \PN.
ja: キキ: 準備ができたら、中庭でわたしに声をかけるといい、\PN。

key: VICTORIA: Since when does lying to everyone count as willpower?
en: VICTORIA: Since when does lying to everyone count as willpower?
ja: ヴィクトリア: いつから、みんなにうそをつくことが意志の力になったんですか?

key: VICTORIA: ... \PN, can you keep a secret?
en: VICTORIA: ... \PN, can you keep a secret?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……\PN、秘密を守れますか?

key: VICTORIA: She's dying.
en: VICTORIA: She's dying.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 先生は、死にかけているんです。

key: Apparently there's no cure.
en: Apparently there's no cure.
ja: 治療法はないそうです。

key: Ever since I came back here, she's been training me to take her place.
en: Ever since I came back here, she's been training me to take her place.
ja: わたしがここに戻ってきてから、先生はずっと、わたしを後継者として鍛えてきました。

key: And I'm the only one who knows.
en: And I'm the only one who knows.
ja: そして、それを知っているのは、わたしだけです。

key: Even now she's pushing herself way harder than she should be.
en: Even now she's pushing herself way harder than she should be.
ja: 今この瞬間も、先生は自分を追い込みすぎています。

key: She won't listen, tell anyone, or ease up...
en: She won't listen, tell anyone, or ease up...
ja: 誰の言葉も聞かず、誰にも話さず、手を抜こうともしない……

key: What, does she think she's just going to go quietly in the night and no one will notice?
en: What, does she think she's just going to go quietly in the night and no one will notice?
ja: まさか、静かに姿を消せば誰も気づかないとでも思っているんでしょうか?

key: Does she really think I can just pick up where she left off perfectly?
en: Does she really think I can just pick up where she left off perfectly?
ja: 先生の後を、わたしが完璧に継げるとでも、本気で思っているんでしょうか?

key: It's not... fair.
en: It's not... fair.
ja: こんなの……不公平です。

key: VICTORIA: ...Fine then.
en: VICTORIA: ...Fine then.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……もう、いいです。

key: VICTORIA: But then nothing is, I guess.
en: VICTORIA: But then nothing is, I guess.
ja: ヴィクトリア: でも、公平なことなんて、そもそも何もないんでしょうね。

key: MARSHADOW: Marrrasha!
en: MARSHADOW: Marrrasha!
ja: マーシャドー: マーッシャ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
